# Acceptance — aiberto-aib-05-chat-ui

Issue: #1128 (AIB-05)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-11-14 -->

## Design

- `.qa/design/aiberto-companion.md`
- Depends on AIB-02 (companion shell) + AIB-04 (`aiberto-ask`)

## Intent

Chat mode in the Aiberto panel: streaming, stop, citation chips → rulebook section, German provider errors; chat RAM-only. Rulebook remains usable when AI is down. Chat tab only when capability/flag is on.

## Preconditions

- AIB-02 companion dock/sheet + RulebookBrowser on main
- AIB-04 host `/api/v1/ai/aiberto-ask` (+ `/stream`) on main
- `VITE_AIBERTO_CHAT_ENABLED` controls Chat tab visibility (default off)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Chat tab visible only when chat capability flag is on
- [ ] Composer posts to host aiberto-ask stream; tokens append; Stop aborts
- [ ] Citation chips navigate to Regelbuch section (same panel)
- [ ] Safe Markdown (no HTML injection)
- [ ] Reload clears chat memory; dock open/width prefs persist
- [ ] Provider/flag errors show DE copy; Rulebook tab still works
- [ ] Self-test wired (prefer not conflicting with AIB-03 e2e hunk)

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Flag off → no Chat tab (Phase-A surface)
- [ ] Unanswered / not-configured / rate-limit → visible DE status, no crash
- [ ] Stream abort mid-flight → partial text kept; idle composer

## Regression

- [ ] Rulebook TOC/search/ORC notice unchanged
- [ ] No Layout/App rewrite beyond companion consumption
- [ ] Avoid AIB-03 files: `e2e/aiberto-phase-a.spec.ts`, `playwright.config.ts`

## Security Coverage

- F-auth: cookie credentials only via host bridge; no secrets in FE
- F-xss: Safe Markdown escapes HTML; no raw `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` of model text
- F-injection: citations are server-validated IDs rendered as chips
- Out of scope: tool cards, server history, confirm writes

## Implementation Notes

- Chat tab gated by `VITE_AIBERTO_CHAT_ENABLED` (default off) via `isAibertoChatEnabled`
- FE client: `src/infrastructure/ai/aiberto-ask-service.ts` → host SSE `/api/v1/ai/aiberto-ask/stream`
- Safe markdown: `safe-chat-markdown.tsx` (React nodes only)
- Citation chips → `RulebookBrowser` controlled `selectedSectionId`
- Self-test: `scripts/aiberto-aib-05-chat-ui.self-test.mjs` (wired in `test-gate.mjs` next to AIB-04; avoids AIB-03 e2e/playwright files)
